summary: Farmhouse, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a Securities Purchase Agreement with Axiom Holdings Group LLC, issuing a $2,222,222 senior unsecured convertible promissory note (10% OID) for $2,000,000 total consideration ($1M cash + $1M digital assets). The note pays 15% interest, matures in 10 months, and automatically converts into common stock at 75% of the lowest 20-day VWAP (floor $0.15, cap $0.50). The transaction funds treasury strategy. This is a structured convertible financing, not a special situation; it is a routine capital raise with material terms disclosed per Items 1.01, 2.03, and 3.02. No merger, tender, or strategic event. Watch for potential dilution from conversion; no risk-arb angle.
